analysis.session_summary: The day was dominated by a broad USD safe-haven bid as Iran/Russia headlines kept risk sentiment fragile; DXY gained 0.431% with SPX down 0.548% and VIX up 0.661%. JPY was second-strongest while AUD and NZD were weakest after RBA press conference comments reversed post-decision gains. US consumer confidence missed badly at 81.9 vs 89.2 but the USD basket reaction was muted, showing the bid was not data-driven.

themes.evidence: USD closed at its best +0.416%; DXY +0.431%, SPX -0.548%, VIX +0.661%; CB Consumer Confidence basket only -0.023%.
AUD strength -0.381%, NZD -0.395%; RBA Press Conference impulse -0.354%; AUD/NZD leg caused by presser and AUD/CHF leg -33.6 pips.
Brent first leg +3.192% then -3.571%; USD/MXN +1.467%, USD/NOK +0.92%, USD/SEK +0.79%; Iran headlines drove early geo premium.

currency_drivers.USD: No clear US data catalyst; safe-haven bid and Iran headlines carried USD to session best.
currency_drivers.EUR: ECB Lagarde was muted; early EUR gain gave back 100% with no euro-specific catalyst.
currency_drivers.JPY: No domestic releases; safe-haven demand kept JPY second-strongest despite broad USD strength.
currency_drivers.GBP: No UK catalyst; sterling held its range while USD dominated major flows.
currency_drivers.AUD: RBA press conference reversed post-decision AUD strength; domestic capacity comments dragged AUD 0.354% weaker.
currency_drivers.CAD: GDP printed inline but CAD firmed 0.044%; larger USD and oil flows set direction.
currency_drivers.CHF: No Swiss catalyst; initial safe-haven bid gave back 83% and CHF closed slightly lower.
currency_drivers.NZD: No NZ catalyst; antipodean underperformance and RBA spillover left NZD weakest of majors.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: The three legs show an initial Iran-risk USD bid (-49.5 pips), a brief Trump-Russia sanction-relief reversal (+21 pips), then an uncatalyzed resumption of USD strength into the close.

polarity_reads.read: No forecast to score, but AUD impulse -0.354% shows the presser was treated as dovish/negative and hit long AUD positioning.
An in-line 4.60% still produced +0.142% AUD impulse, suggesting over-hedged AUD shorts were squeezed.
Big miss (81.9 vs 89.2) moved USD basket only -0.023%, confirming USD demand was safe-haven, not data-driven.
Muted -0.019% basket reaction shows no policy signal and no fresh EUR positioning impulse.
Inline 0.0% with CAD +0.044% implies CAD strength came from other drivers, not a growth surprise.

scenarios.name: Geopolitical risk-off persists
scenarios.thesis: Iran/Russia headlines keep markets defensive into US data; USD remains bid and high-beta FX stays heavy.
scenarios.invalidation: Concrete Iran de-escalation or strong risk-on US equity bounce.

pair_paths.rationale: USD safe-haven bid continues with no euro catalyst to offset.
AUD remains fragile after RBA presser and risk-off adds pressure.
Broad USD bid outweighs CAD firmness from inline GDP.

scenarios.name: De-escalation and risk-on rebound
scenarios.thesis: Iran/Russia headlines fade or turn concrete, oil gives back geo premium, and dip-buyers rebuild risk positions.
scenarios.invalidation: New escalation or unexpected hawkish US data.

pair_paths.rationale: USD safe-haven bid unwinds and euro rebounds toward prior range highs.
Antipodean bounce after RBA-led liquidation and risk-on recovery.
JPY weakens as safe-haven flows reverse even if USD softens.

scenarios.name: Consolidation ahead of US data
scenarios.thesis: Markets hold ranges into ADP/PCE/GDP without new Iran headlines or data surprises.
triggers: ADP and core PCE near forecast
scenarios.invalidation: Break of daily ranges on data surprise or headline shock.

pair_paths.rationale: Pair consolidates within its 72-pip daily range before PCE.
Yield differentials not repricing ahead of US data.
RBA reaction digested; no new AUD catalyst before CPI.

risks.why_it_matters: Could extend USD safe-haven bid, lift oil, and pressure high-beta and commodity currencies.
risks.watch: Al Hadath/Axios headlines, IRGC statements, Trump comments.

risks.risk: Hot US core PCE or hawkish data surprise
risks.why_it_matters: Would validate USD strength and may push Fed pricing to keep risk assets defensive.
risks.watch: Core PCE m/m forecast 0.3%, Final GDP, ADP.

risks.why_it_matters: After RBA presser damage, a soft CPI could trigger another AUD/NZD leg lower.
risks.watch: AUD CPI m/m forecast 0.5%, y/y 4.1%, trimmed mean.

risks.why_it_matters: Brent moves are feeding directly into NOK, SEK, CAD and inflation expectations.
risks.watch: Brent close 106.43 and any US strategic reserve headlines.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: AUD CPI at 03:30 is the first major test after the RBA presser; German CPI, US ADP, core PCE and final GDP can either validate the USD bid or force a sharp unwind.
